# HDREZKA Anime4K Motion 2.1.0

> Unofficial open-source Windows x64 HDRezka client with integrated Anime4K image processing, independent OpenCL motion interpolation and redesigned movie browsing UI.

- [Русский README](README.md): Feature overview, download, requirements, update guide and limitations.
- [English README](README.en.md): English overview and installation.
- [Release 2.1 details](docs/RELEASE_2.1.md): Catalog, genres, UI, comments, migration and test scope.
- [User guide / Руководство](docs/USER_GUIDE.md): Navigation, playback, catalog, comments, updates, troubleshooting.
- [Full changelog](CHANGELOG.md): v2.1.0 release notes and earlier changes.
- [Build](docs/BUILD.md): Reproducible Windows x64 build and checks.
- [Publishing](docs/RELEASES.md): Stable/test release workflows.
- [Updater](docs/UPDATER.md): Release catalog, SHA-256 verification, backup and rollback.
- [Licenses](THIRD_PARTY.md): Upstream attribution and dependency source references.
- [Stable 2.1 release](https://github.com/Tridgi/hdrezka-anime4k-motion/releases/tag/v2.1.0): Portable ZIP and SHA256SUMS.txt.

Facts: Windows 10 build 19041+ / Windows 11, x64. Anime4K Off/A/B/C/Light. Independent 60/120/experimental 165 FPS via SVPflow/VapourSynth/OpenCL; 165 is not guaranteed. Custom themes, genre parsing from the active mirror, collections, comments and stable/test updates. No bundled accounts or media. Not DLSS or RIFE. Source website restrictions, authentication and CAPTCHA remain external. This is not an official HDRezka release.
